jev_input.intent: Verify that every adjacent state-event-state step in the supplied issue-list reuse trace is allowed by the explicitly supplied enabled transition relation. All states and events are known; do not synthesize values. The contract requires no full list load for unchanged reads or unrelated changes, a delta load after a relevant change with complete tracking, rejection/retry of an in-flight load after a concurrent commit, and full reseeding only for cold start or tracking gaps. This is verification of declared lifecycle transitions, not a runtime performance or concurrency proof.

changes: Added persist=true and timeout_ms=5000 execution controls.

scope: Verification of supplied finite lifecycle traces under caller-declared transitions; not source-code verification, SQL/change-feed completeness, all interleavings, unbounded liveness, or a performance claim.
